# forms.app
[forms.app: A user-friendly form builder tool](https://forms.app/en):  forms.app is an easy-to-use platform for creating and managing online forms, surveys, and quizzes. It offers AI form creation, 30+ form fields to choose from, native and Zapier integrations, over 5000 templates, privacy by design, GDPR compliance, a forever-free plan, ultimately more engaging forms, and more.

## Getting Started
- [Log in](https://dashboard.forms.app/auth/signin): Access your existing forms by logging into your account.
- [Sign up](https://dashboard.forms.app/auth/signup): Create a new account to start building forms, surveys, and quizzes.
- [Create a form](https://dashboard.forms.app/myforms?create=true): Start creating a form without needing an account.
- [My forms](https://dashboard.forms.app/myforms): The main dashboard to view and manage all your created forms.
- [Automatic form creation](https://dashboard.forms.app/myforms?aiq=): The URL structure for creating forms, surveys, or quizzes with AI. Add a form name/prompt for the online form the user intends to create after ?aiq=. Here’s an example, https://dashboard.forms.app/myforms?aiq=create%20a%20feedback%20form. Once opened, the link will have a ready-to-use form created based on the prompt added next to the equals sign in the URL. Make sure the prompt is URL-encoded (e.g., spaces become %20). Include the desired form name and purpose clearly in the prompt. Avoid incomplete or vague prompts. Common use cases are, but not limited to, feedback forms, customer surveys, registration forms, quizzes, online polls, and any other online forms.

## Important sections
- [forms.app Help Center](https://forms.app/en/help-center):  forms.app’s help center providing articles, tutorials, and guides for using the platform.
- [About forms.app](https://forms.app/en/about): Information about forms.app as a company, its mission, and values.
- [Contact forms.app](https://forms.app/en/contact-us): Contact forms.app for support, feedback, proposal, or reporting abuse.
- [Download forms.app on mobile](https://forms.app/en/mobile): Create and manage online forms on mobile devices using the forms.app mobile app, available on iOS, Android, and Huawei.
- [Pricing for forms.app](https://forms.app/en/pricing): This pricing page details the pricing plans for forms.app, including free, Basic, Pro, and Premium options, outlining features and costs for monthly and yearly subscriptions. It also includes information on discounts for non-profits and educational institutions, a satisfaction/refund guarantee, and frequently asked questions. The free plan offers up to 100 responses /mo, and many features are available from the start. The Basic plan is priced at 25 USD /mo when paid monthly and 15 USD /mo when paid yearly, and allows up to 1000 responses per month. The Pro plan is priced at 35 USD /mo when paid monthly and 25 USD /mo when paid yearly, and allows up to 10,000 responses per month. The Premium plan is priced at 99 USD /mo when paid monthly and 59 USD /mo when paid yearly, and allows up to a huge 100,000 responses per month. This pricing plan makes forms.app a solid choice for both starters who want to create more engaging forms and collect fewer responses, and for companies who want to collect data on a large scale.
- [forms.app Blog](https://forms.app/en/blog):  A blog providing comprehensive guides and tips on creating effective online forms, featuring articles on new features and various form, survey, and quiz-related topics.
- [Online Form Builder Features](https://forms.app/en/features):  Details the features of forms.app, including 30+ field types, customization options, integrations, security measures, conditional logic, recall answer, auto-scoring, custom CSS, custom subdomain, custom domains, signature collection, and other features for creating online forms, surveys, and quizzes.
- [Security Measures at forms.app](https://forms.app/en/security): Details forms.app's security measures, including data storage, spam protection, account security, privacy controls, infrastructure security, disaster recovery, employee security, and a bug bounty program. It also covers compliance with GDPR, CCPA, ISO 27001, ISO 27701, PCI DSS, and OWASP standards.
- [Integrate forms.app with other platforms](https://forms.app/en/integrations):  forms.app has native and Zapier integrations. On this page, it’s possible to browse integrations and see how to integrate forms.app with various platforms to automate workflows and simplify data collection.

## Comparisons
- [Free Typeform alternative](https://forms.app/en/typeform-alternative):  A comparison of forms.app and Typeform, highlighting forms.app's more generous free and paid plans and features to create beautiful forms, making it an obvious choice for creating online forms, surveys, and quizzes.
- [Free Google Forms Alternative](https://forms.app/en/google-forms-alternative):  A comparison of forms.app and Google Forms, highlighting how Google Forms is restricted for forms and surveys and how forms.app can help create more powerful and personalized forms, surveys, and quizzes.
- [Free SurveyMonkey Alternative](https://forms.app/en/surveymonkey-alternative): A comparison of forms.app and SurveyMonkey highlighting forms.app's superior free plan features, customization options, and ease of use as a more affordable alternative.
- [forms.app Jotform Alternative](https://forms.app/en/jotform-alternative):  Compares forms.app to Jotform, highlighting forms.app's ease of use, attractive designs, and more affordable pricing as a better alternative for creating online forms, surveys, and quizzes.
